content.label:
App looks great in principle, but sadly just doesn’t work. When I tap to add to my streak, the app often fails to record progress. Sometimes it reverts entirely back to zero for a day. Super frustrating. Using with iPhone X/Apple Watch SE. 

Would update to 5 stars if issue was fixed.
I really like this app but I wish you could have more than 2 pages of 6 tasks. The widgets look really clean but that 12 task limit really does hurt :/

Really smooth, beautifully designed app with lots of great features. 

Kudos to the devs - excellent work!

If my goal is to post on Instagram 3 times a week, is it possible to have my task display 1/3 progress if I’ve posted once earlier this week? It’s more conducive to productivity to see that you’re 1/3, 2/3 or 3/3 for the week instead of 0/1 or 1/1 for the day. If you have weekly goals it should display in fractions for the week not for a single day. Is this possible?

I think the app is wonderfully uncomplicated, my feedback is in regards to the widget specifically: 

Good start however lacks usable functionality. Beyond a simple preview the widget opens and directs the user to complete the task in app (seemingly redundant) This widget would really come into its own if the task could be activated via the widget interface. 

I hope to see this functionality in the near future. I think it would help support remembering to use the app to begin with, which is the fundamental flaw of any app these day (lack of presence)

title.label: iOS 14 is messing with certain goals

content.label: Since updating to iOS 14, certain goals get an X in the middle of the day for some reason. I have to go into the edit page and reset the goal to remain available for the day. I’ve never had this bug before — please fix it so I can go back to thinking of this as a 5-star app!

I love how this app turns forming a new habit or sustaining a current habit into what feels like an achievement in a video game.
Seamless, simple and fun. 
You should try it out!
I never know I’d it automatically completes for me or if I am checking it off
I’ve tried them all, including paid ones. This is worth the money. Don’t ever pay for a subscription to an app for this purpose!
I have tried many things in the past to gain new habits but nothing has ever worked. Then this app came along and literally improved my productivity 200%!!! Great app!!
Stupid app, doesn’t achieve more than a reminder , hard to maneuver ,not sure why Apple is promoting it, waste of money and would like a refund

Really, this app has changed my life!! Everyday I look forward to doing my everyday tasks with this app. When I get done with a task “ie work out, reading, brushing my teeth (the small things)” to see that number go up everyday is quite rewarding ! I’ve also kept up with water intake thanks to this app!!!

title.label: Good, but needs to be better

content.label:
This app has a lot more potential, particularly for breaking bad habits.

I do not think I could stop touching my face entirely cold turkey, but the only info I can record is that I failed to completely abstain. It would be helpful if I could count the number of times I touched my face by holding down the habit icon. Then I could track gradual improvements over time.

The most success I have had is with a daily push-up habit. But again I can’t record if I do a second set. Similarly, if I back off a bit one day and only do a set of 40 reps instead of 50, I ought to count the streak broken. However, doing a partial set could be a big win some days, and it would be nice if I could enter reps on the habit icon after pushing it.

So, please allow multiple counts of habits, and please allow a custom complication for some habits prompting a rep count or duration.

title.label: Keeps completing the task as soon as I start

content.label: I have a drink water streak. And every time I set it up it completes the goal for me.

title.label: Glitching since I installed the Mac version

content.label:
I’ve had two issues in the last 24 hours.  The app started automatically marking all of my streaks a fail after 12am

And now I open the app and one of my streaks is GONE!

I’ve never had any issues until I installed the Mac app
If I were going to summarize this app in two words, effectively smart.

Developer offers friendly support when issues are encountered and keeps his software up to the latest standards. 
Congratulations on a job well done!

title.label: Great app! Use it for my physio exercices.

content.label:
I use it to remind myself of every physio exercise that i have to do every day. It wirks well, simple, motivating, no complaints. Highly recommend to people around me.

@ the developers, here’s a few things that i would like you to add/change : 
-icons: more simple positions, so that they correspond to physio exercises better. Take a person standing, then put their arms in various positions; then do the same with someone sitting, pushing against a wall; you can look some up, i think I’m probably not the only one who uses it for that!
-icons turning gold: honestly, that’s the most motivating part for me, not so much the streaks. Can you make it so that if you only have 2, 3, 4 icons on there (rest is empty), that it still turns gold when you’ve finished them? Currently it only turns gold if you have 6/6, but not 5/5, 4/4, etc.
-icons: physio exercises look alike, so it would be cool if we could color-code the individual icons for easier recognition 
-make it so that when you’re interrupted doing a timed task, you can save your progress to catch up later

I set two new years resolutions for myself this year.  Coding something every day and giving up drinking pop, cold turkey.  I’ve attempted both of these in the past and was never able to stick with it.  Turns out my addiction to drinking pop was less consuming than my addiction to watching the stupid little number tick up everyday.  Both habits are at 55 days and I’m looking to add another to my daily routine.  These apps have never worked for me in the past, but for some reason this time it just clicked.

title.label: Change your habits, change your life.

content.label: This is a great app to help you with changing your daily habits. While you can only have 12 habits tracked at one time, it offers great flexibility in the way that they look, and when you can get reminders for completion. It's simplistic design removes the flood that you don't need allowing you to focus on getting things done. It also has a companion Apple Watch complication to make logging your completions in a seamless easy manner. One of my favourite things about this app is you can change the colour of your icon for your screen. If you are OCD this makes your life. The only thing I would change is allowing you to drop habits and archive them to use again later.
Having your own personal video game where you can get better at stuff in real life is an amazing outcome. The app is super simple, but detailed when it needs to be. It’s changed my life.

Simple perfect app at a great price (except to those weirdos who think all software should be free).
Only thing: would be nice to have more than 12 items. Not all habits are daily. But this is a minor quibble. Clearly a lot of thought went into the design. An hour after you have set it up you will feel like you been using it forever. 
Truly impressive.

This gets pretty amazing reviews so I guess I was just expecting a bit more. I like that it’s simple, however for being so simple some things still don’t seem very intuitive. It took me about 30 minutes to finally figure out how to delete a task, and that was after reading the FAQ and googling.

I didn’t download this app today,but it downloaded by itself and charged me 7.90.
Why?l don’t need this app.I deleted it.please rebate my money.
I definitely give 5 stars to this amazing APP.
Keeps me focused on completing my daily tasks. Love the layout and user-friendly interface.

Cool app except the options to choose at what time your day starts is incomplete since it doesn’t give you 24h choices. Being someone who works nights I would like to be able to start my day at 11pm but the app only allows up to 9pm latest

I really enjoy using a Streaks with my behavior change goals. Whether it be journaling consistently or avoiding sugar, the app makes it so easy and fun to keep track of my streaks. The only additional feature I'd love to see is a "vacation mode" where I have the option to pause my streaks while I'm away or not in a regular routine. Other than that, this is a beautiful app.
I tried other apps like this and so far this is the only one that has kept me motivated.

It’s a beautifully designed app, love the colours the sounds and the amount of customization you can do.

The weird part is in the organization, you get a maximum of 12 habits, no more, which is okay because that’s a lot, but they’re split into two groups of 6, and you can only make changes to one of those groups at a time, not all the habits.

The app doesn’t give you any information on how many habits you completed on a given day, or a history of all your habits so that you can see your progress over time... it only gives you stats on each habit, and for some reason on the groups of 6 habits that you have (again, weird). It gives you graphs and pie charts and all that, but not a simple “this is how many out of 12 you completed each day” to see your improvement over time.

I have been looking for a habit manager that can make a habit due (show the red badge) at a specified time of the day rather than since 00:01. For example, one of my habit is to read book, but I usually do it after work, around 6pm, so I don’t want to see the red badge, before 6pm as it is not due yet. Most of the App don't give you this option and your habit is due since 00.01. After spending so much money on different Apps, I eventually find this App and I’m so happy with it.
Easy to use, simple and effective. Appreciate the fee is one time only and not a monthly/yearly subscription. Would like the option of tracking more than 6 habits in the future.

title.label: This great app can be so much better

content.label: Love the app but i need more streaks.  1) Allow unlimited streaks; 2) sort the streaks automagically according to which is next up - i have some streaks that are only once a week and some a few times a week and some daily... put ones that aren’t due today at the bottom of the list.

I really like your app, but slowly the features I like are disappearing.

Everything it needs to be. No features locked behind paywalls or ridiculous subscriptions. Interface is simple and extremely vibrant and customizable. I was happily surprised by how many pre generated habits they had set up and the hundreds of icons to choose from when creating your own goals. Track habits in pretty much every way. Simple to use once you’ve set up all personal features. Statistics for each goal are simple but still in depth. Satisfying  checking off completed goals. Never bombarded with reminders but are helpful when needed. Lastly, and probably the best feature, the lock screen/home widget is super convenient to see at glance all daily habits and check them off as completed without opening the app. 
For the price of a cup of coffee this is a must for productivity in my opinion and the best habit tracker currently in the App Store. Extremely pleased with this app👍
Such a great design! Simple to use and always there to encourage you to reach your goals!
